description: Dive deep into the fascinating early journey of Unitree, the Chinese startup behind those viral robot dogs and humanoids, with insights from early investor Peng Zhang, founder of Geek Park and Variable Capital. This episode goes beyond the polished demos to unpack the real story: the crucial technical decisions, the struggles, and the unique character of founder Wang Xing. Discover what Unitree's path reveals about the new generation of Chinese tech entrepreneurs and the nature of deep tech inno…
classificationReason: Focused discussion of Unitree’s robot dogs and humanoids, including technical decisions, founder history, and deep-tech company building.
qualityReason: Likely substantive investor interview with original company and technical-development insights.
